title: Lucky Thirteen Black Widow Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Black Widow dares to blend sweet and spicy to delicious effect, with sweet, tart berry notes layered over a subtle streak of warming aniseed for an irresistible vape experience. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
